full_page.content:
1924, July
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 1
Page 13 Cont.
July 28 Viola LaMothe (32 of 789 Westminister Rd. Brooklyn) now 3rd time and 17 months mentally depressed in St. Vincent's Retreat Harri- son, N.Y. Doctor says only a positive miracle will cure her. Mother heart broken and almost in dispair, Enrolls herself & said daughter, promising more frequently to receive Holy Communion. The foregoing not was forgotten, but word was received of said girl's recovery. April 5th 1926
DETROIT
DETROIT
August 10 Briget Gordon 49 now in Dearborne Asylum 15 months Enrolled To- day perpetual member.
Hemorages Irene Berznk (5 of 4453 -24 St) Suffering three yrs from hemorages joined to-day for 6 yrs
14 Richard Ostrowski (2 - 2234 E. Hancock St) paralized in one leg - Enrolled To-day.
Peter DeCuyper 38 cripple - 1135 Lakepointe - lost both legs and part of hand through Enrolled gratis To-day.
Page 14
Aug. 15th Bertha Stocker (Mrs. 29 of 5026 Fair Vue Ave) sickly, Sickly, Sickly for 22 month and discouraged. joins S.M.A. To-day for two yrs. promising if ---- to do more & receive often.
18 Emma Gust Lutheran (23 - 3620 Elber St. ) Absent from home a week, Lutheran mother heart-broken Enrolles enrolles her To-day for two years in S.M.A.
18 Joseph Prazechowski (33 married 2nd time abuses wife terribly) who, heartbroken, about such treatment and about divorce applied for in court enrolles her husband for year To-day.
19 Ferdinand Huntelyson (38 Cor. 2nd & High St) makes good wages, penniless through drink is Enrolled to-day by his Father.
20 Cancer Cured of Man 80 years old. Louis Grouillet of (81 Summers) 3779 Burns Ave. Anxious lest cancer Eat away his hand Enrolled To- day - perpetual Member.
